status: Proposed relational contract; not an applied migration

conventions.money: PostgreSQL numeric with explicit ISO currency; preserve source precision, settle/round at the documented charge boundary
conventions.time: timestamptz for known instants; retain source text, timezone and precision; do not invent unknown times
conventions.null: Unknown, never an implicit zero; applicability and availability are separate enum values
conventions.keys: Stable local UUIDs for domain entities; source SHA identifies content, not physical ownership
conventions.provenance: Source locator and assertion remain immutable; corrections create new mappings, observations or events
conventions.scope: Single-owner local application. No tenancy/auth infrastructure required by this contract.

entities.name: source_artifacts
entities.grain: One retained source capture with scope and lineage
constraints: Keep a capture even when content repeats; content bytes may deduplicate by hash
Role and scope required before stock reconciliation

entities.name: source_rows
entities.grain: One row or bounded evidence excerpt in a capture

entities.name: catalog_objects
entities.grain: One provider object at a catalog capture, not a physical holding
constraints: Collector number stays text including suffixes
No catalog-only price becomes an executable bid

entities.name: variants
entities.grain: One locally resolved printed product and finish/treatment/language combination
constraints: Scryfall UUID is an external mapping, not the complete physical variant key
Do not collapse treatments or assert an unknown language is English
Unresolved identity retained until evidenced

entities.name: external_mappings
entities.grain: One versioned assertion mapping a provider product to a local variant
constraints: Provider keys may encompass several variants; candidate mappings cannot execute sales
Accepted mapping must record relevant finish, language and condition scope

entities.name: lots
entities.grain: Physical copies sharing variant, condition, location and verification provenance
constraints: Two identical variants in separate boxes may be separate lots
No blanket unique key on variant/condition
Owner scan is provenance, not independent app inspection
Quantity derives from events, not latest market export

entities.name: reconciliations
entities.grain: One accepted or proposed inventory snapshot comparison for a declared physical scope
constraints: Subset absence creates no depletion
One accepted current reconciliation head per scope
Reordered CSV or changed reference values cannot imply new copies

entities.name: reconciliation_lines
entities.grain: A proposed source-row to physical-lot resolution and quantity difference
constraints: New/missing/split/merge differences require explicit resolution before event generation
Do not infer sale from missing quantity

entities.name: stock_events
constraints: Atomic lot locking and nonnegative balances in every owned state
A reservation moves available to reserved; never decrements physical ownership
Outbound is unavailable but not necessarily finalized sold
Returns and corrections are explicit compensating events
Opening baseline accepted once per physical lot

entities.name: observations
entities.grain: One metric assertion for a provider subject and time/period
constraints: At least one value supplied; zero preserved
Mapping may be unresolved without losing evidence
Demand and bid must be paired from compatible source/time/product conditions
A sales count needs a window before rate calculation
Observations reusable across physical lots without multiplying demand

entities.name: quotes
entities.grain: One provider offer scope, state and validity
constraints: Approved is still subject to its documented grade/fulfillment conditions
Event quote is not assumed identical to web buylist

entities.name: quote_lines
entities.grain: One quoted product/demand pool or inseparable bundle
constraints: Known capacity may be zero; unknown must be null
Sum of simultaneous allocations cannot exceed known capacity
Bundle total cannot be multiplied by card quantity

entities.name: policy_versions
entities.grain: Immutable fee, shipping, effort or decision-assumption configuration
constraints: Unknown input retained; no silent arbitrary risk or effort haircut

entities.name: decision_runs
entities.grain: One reproducible analysis with pinned evidence and policies
constraints: Pin catalog, evidence and physical availability cutoffs
Keep tool/model cost and review effort when measuring benefit

entities.name: decisions
entities.grain: One lot/group proposal, including alternatives and allocation
constraints: Evidence and assumption IDs required
Structured outputs do not themselves reserve or sell inventory
Group scope enumerates exact lots/quantities; no hidden overlapping allocation
Owner override is separate from original AI proposal

entities.name: transactions
entities.grain: One retail order or dealer disposal batch
constraints: Null external ID does not deduplicate unrelated proposed orders
Order state and payment state are distinct

entities.name: transaction_lines
entities.grain: Allocated lot copies under one transaction
constraints: Accepted plus returned cannot exceed allocated quantity
Active allocations lock/reserve the same physical copies once

entities.name: cash_entries
entities.grain: One actual or estimated receipt, fee, cost, refund or adjustment
constraints: Payout is settlement of proceeds, not additional revenue
Estimated and actual entries never add together in realized net
Refunds/returns do not automatically imply the same stock event

implementation_notes: This is a logical contract, not a requirement to create all tables at once. Some workflow JSON can remain structured JSONB until query needs justify more tables.
Forward references can be nullable until execution tables exist. Before sales, atomic allocation and capacity constraints must be implemented and tested.
Existing source_files/source_records map to artifact/row provenance. Keep original IDs through an explicit migration crosswalk.
Seed current lots only once from the accepted baseline. Existing inventory_holdings remain snapshot history; never sum snapshots as current stock.
Migrate existing observations by their original source subject. Preserve all unmatched and partial-match assertions, not only linked holdings.
Preserve historical recommendations as imported decisions with historical input manifest, never accepted model output.
DDL, service methods, index choices and production migrations follow review of this contract. No schema described here was applied during reanalysis.
